facts: Original post preserved in jd.txt. No company, client name, staff names, addresses, timezone, duration values or offer price is provided.
Jamie, Riley, Alex, Location 1/2, dates, durations and all sample messages are synthetic illustrative fixtures.
Approx 4,000 existing contacts and two-week target are post requirements, not completed delivery claims.

Native GHL reminder builder uses verified Appointment Status trigger, appointment-relative Wait, SMS and Email actions. Additional timing, stage and suppression proof remains an explicitly custom test fixture.
Public Neo widget based on official calendar-widget-customization reference, historical screenshot qualified in preparation.md. No real iframe, backend or service calls.
Chosen bounded sample: separate Neo Round Robin calendar per location/service. Services v2 is not depicted.
Review timing is end+2h, not start+2h. Live mapping, reminders, reschedules, DND and external registration require implementation/testing.
No medspa experience, GHL funnel URLs, A2P approvals or improvement metrics invented.

Official Appointment Status and Wait references checked Oct20,2026. Both locations is an illustrative calendar group containing four separate location/service calendars. Graph only represents the confirmed-reminder path; no-show, showed, missed-call, stage-update and suppression cases in custom fixture are distinct planned automations, not actions depicted on this graph.

Avery Ellis is a separate consented test fixture in the timing record. Visitor SMS checkbox can be withdrawn without cancelling the booking; confirmation shows SMS held. The record does not assert that an unchecked visitor receives SMS.
